description: Read one repair guide's full steps once you have its slug; use search_repair_guides to find slugs by model, component or words. Returns Markdown steps with manual page citations, the official manual URL, the service classification and scope restrictions, typically 2 to 17 KB. The slug must match exactly (case and surrounding spaces ignored); an unknown slug is an error result: No guide "<slug>". Use search_repair_guides. Not bench-tested: follow the scope restrictions and the OEM manual. Read-only.

slug.description: Required. Guide slug from search_repair_guides, e.g. "hp-elitebook-840-g6-battery-replacement".

name: get_repair_guide

fit_status.description: Present when there is no fit or no result: LPF has no OEM document for it. Never means incompatible.

title: Get a repair guide
